title: Raka T.V. & Furnitures Traders vs Mr. Shaikh Rais Shaikh Rashid on 29 September, 2010
doc:
Raka T.V. & Furnitures Traders vs Mr. Shaikh Rais Shaikh Rashid on 29 September, 2010

                                   1                       F.A. No..: 1697-06



     STATE CONSUMER DISPUTE REDRESSAL COMMISSION,
         MUMBAI, CIRCUIT BENCH AT AURANGABAD.

                                          Date of filing : 30.08.2006
                                          Date of Order: 29.09.2010

FIRST APPEAL NO. 1697 OF 2006
IN COMPLAINT CASE NO. 195 OF 2006
DISTRICT CONSUMER FORUM: JALGAON.

Raka T.V. & Furnitures Traders
Gandhi Chowk, Patil Enterprises,
Bhusawal, Tal. Bhusawal,
Dist. Jalgaon.                                        ... Appellant

       //VERSUS//

Mr. Shaikh Rais Shaikh Rashid
R/o. Ramdaswadi, Khadka Road,
Bhusawal, Tal. Bhusawal, Dist. Jalgaon.           ... Respondent

Coram : Shri.S.G.Deshmukh, Hon`ble Presiding Judicial Member.

Mrs. Uma S.Bora, Hon`ble Member.

Present: Adv. Shri. Hemant Bhangale, for appellant.

Respondent appeared in person.

- :: O R A L O R D E R ::-

Mrs. Uma S.Bora, Hon`ble Member.
1. Raka T.V. & Furniture Traders, Bhusawal, original opponent challenges in this appeal order passed by District Consumer Forum, 2 F.A. No..: 1697-06 Jalgaon on 29.07.2006 while deciding the complaint case No. 195/2006.
2. Facts of the case are as under:
Complainant Shaikh Rais Shaikh Rashid, resident of Bhusawal purchased colour Television (T.V.) of Samsung Company by Model No. 21" 58 on 25.11.2004 for Rs. 15,500/-. Accordingly, bill No. 968 was issued by the appellant to the complainant. It is found immediately after purchase of said T.V. that, TV is not running properly. Picture on the screen were disturbing, voice of the television set fluctuates automatically etc. It is also doubted by the complainant that television is locally assembled, but sold by appellant with label of Samsung Company. Therefore, complainant approached to appellant and demanded refund of the amount or replacement of television. Appellant sent one mechanic to the house of complainant. Said mechanic inspected the TV and informed the complainant that, there is picture fault and it can be rectified in the workshop only. Therefore, complainant approached to appellant and requested to repair the said television, but appellant did not pay heed. Therefore, complainant issued legal notice dated 01.02.2005. Appellant did not issue the warranty card with the bill of TV therefore, the doubt of complainant that TV given by appellant is not of Samsung Company, but it was locally assembled, was strengthen then complainant approached to Forum.
3 F.A. No..: 1697-06
3. Appellant appeared before Forum and denied the claim. It is submitted by appellant that, the allegation of the complainant that, locally assembled TV was sold by appellant with label of Samsung company is not true. No any complaint received from the complainant about non-functioning of TV. Mechanic from the shop visited the house of complainant and tried to rectify the problem. It is further submitted that, for the manufacturing defects in the goods not the dealer but manufacturer is liable. As manufacturer is not made party to the complaint, complaint is not maintainable.
4. After hearing both the parties District Forum directed appellant to replace the TV or refund the amount of Rs. 15,300/- with interest @ 6 % p.a. from the date of purchase.
5. Dissatisfied with the said judgment and order original opponent came in appeal.
6. Notices of final hearing were served on both the parties. Adv.

Hemant Bhangale appeared for appellant and respondent appeared in person. Adv. Bhangale vehemently argued the case. He submitted that, as the complaint about no-functioning of TV was received, immediately mechanic was sent to the house of complainant to rectify the defect. Therefore, there is no deficiency in service on the part of appellant. Appellant is a dealer of goods and not 4 F.A. No..: 1697-06 manufacturer. For the complaint of manufacturing defect manufacturer is liable. As the complainant did not make manufacture as a party to the complaint, complaint is not sustainable for non- joinder of party. Adv. Bhangale further submitted that, the District Forum failed to consider the fact that dealer is only intermediater between the manufacturer and consumer and he is wrongly ordered to refund the amount or replace the TV set. In support of his argument he produced the citation of National Commission-

7. i) In Classic Automobiles Vs. Lila Nand Mishra & Anr., reported in I- (2010) CPJ 235 (NC). It is held by Hon'ble National Commission that, Manufacturing defects - Joint and several liability imposed on manufacturer absolved in appeal - Entire liability fixed on dealer - Hence revision - Onus to prove manufacturing defect lies on complainant - No expert evidence produced to prove defects cannot be termed as manufacturing defect - No expert evidence produced to prove manufacturing defect in vehicle.

It is also held by Hon'ble National Commission that, dealer not liable unless show that, vehicle sold by manufacturer on principal to principal basis. Dealer being a intermediator between consumer and manufacturer, liability for manufacturing defect to be fixed on manufacturer.

5 F.A. No..: 1697-06

ii) In Abhinandan Vs. Ajit Kumar Verma & Ors., reported in I (2008) CPJ 336 (NC). It is held by Hon'ble National Commission that, Dealer can not be held liable for manufacturing defects in VCP- Orders of Fora below not legally sustainable.

Both these authorities are not applicable to the instant case as in both the cases manufacturer was party to the complaint, but he was exempted from the liability by the Forum. Therefore, it is held that, only dealer can not be held liable.

8. In the instant case, manufacturer is not party to the complaint. In our view, dealer can get reimbursed the price from manufacturer which he has to pay to the consumer for manufacturing defect of the goods. In the case on hand dealer is made party to the complaint, manufacturer is not party. As dealer was directed to replace the TV set or to refund the price, he can recover the said amount from the company, as he is authorized dealer of the company.

9. Respondent in person submitted that, immediately after purchase of TV it is found that, there are manufacturing defects in the TV set, therefore they approached to appellant. The mechanic from appellant inspected the TV set and informed the complainant that, there is picture problem which can be rectified at the workshop, but appellant avoided to rectify the said TV set. On the contrary, appellant behaved arrogantly with the complainant. It is submitted 6 F.A. No..: 1697-06 by complainant that, manufacturing defects are found in the warranty period therefore, complainant is entitled to the replacement of the TV set. It is also submitted by respondent that, as the appellant supplied locally assembled TV with label of Samsung he did not issue the warranty card of the company and thereby committed unfair trade practice. As appellant is guilty of unfair trade practice he avoided to give the proper service. Manufacturing defects were found in the warranty period therefore, TV set can be replaced and dealer can get it compensated by the company. But, appellant avoided to redress the grievance of complainant, therefore District Forum has rightly granted the relief.

10. We heard both the parties at sufficient length and perused the record. Appellant is a dealer of Samsung Company. The TV set started giving problems of manufacturing defects in warranty period therefore; complainant is entitled for replacement of the TV set or refund of amount. A person purchasing new goods for his satisfaction, was constrained to approach the dealer or service center again and again for repair of the new article is really causing mental torture. As the manufacturing defects are found in warranty period, appellant is liable to replace the TV set or refund the amount. We relied on the citations of Hon'ble National Commission.

a. In Maruti Suzuki (India) Ltd., Vs. Adulapuram Buchiraju & Ors., III (2008) CPJ 119 (NC). It is held by National Commission 7 F.A. No..: 1697-06 that, various defects noticed within warranty - Replacement of engine and gear box advised by dealer - Consumer entitled to replacement of vehicle.

b. In Kinetic Engineering (P) Ltd. & Anr. Vs. Santosh Kumar Prasad, III (2008) CPJ 266. It is held by Delhi State Commission - False representation made regarding high average of vehicle - Unfair trade practice - Brand new vehicle/goods if start giving trouble, time and again person is forced to take it to workshop, still defect continues, vehicle/goods to be declared defective.

District Forum rightly considered all the facts and record while allowing the complaint. We are not inclined to interfere the judgment and order of District Forum. We pass following order.

O R D ER

1. Appeal is dismissed.

2. Appellant to pay Rs.1,000/- as cost to the respondent.

3. Copy of the order be furnished to the parties. 

      (Mrs. Uma S. Bora)                       (S. G. Deshmukh)
           Member                               Presiding Judicial Member
Kalyankar
